entities.name: Blue
entities.description: One of the five colors of mana, drawn from islands and embodying logic, technology and the belief that anyone can be improved.

entities.name: White
entities.description: A color allied with blue, valued for discipline but seen by blue as fatally rigid.

entities.name: Black
entities.description: A color allied with blue through mutual usefulness, valued for rationality but distrusted for its vicious decay.

entities.name: Red
entities.description: An enemy color of blue, seen as foolish and dangerous for acting immediately on emotion.

entities.name: Green
entities.description: An enemy color of blue, seen as the color of stubborn ignorance.

entities.name: Council of Colors
entities.description: The body whose current blue member is Megan Smith.

entities.name: Zendikari Krakens
entities.description: Sea monsters said to embody blue's free will and self-determination, spending most of their adult lives in the depths.
